records.quote: This comparison builds on recent findings indicating that expatriate ELT faculty with teacher qualifications reported significantly higher affective and normative commitment to both their organizations and the profession (Moodie, 2023).
records.reason: The paper explicitly follows up Moodie (2023)'s qualification-related commitment finding with a broader sample, and the results report the qualification comparison. The supplied shipped list contains only McInerney et al. (2015), a different paper.

records.quote: A secondary purpose was to replicate and extend Lanovaz and Hranchuk (2021) by examining correspondence between visual inspection, the conservative dual-criteria method, and the machine-learning algorithms on a novel dataset. We extended both studies by using clinical data and adding a 10-point scale with definitional criteria to visual-inspection ratings.
records.reason: This directly states a retest of Lanovaz and Hranchuk (2021) on a novel clinical dataset. The only supplied shipped original is Wolfe et al. (2018), a different paper.

records.quote: Firstly, we present new 14C measurements over the period from 771–779 CE, spanning the years of the 775 CE event. Our results show the same sharp rise shown by Miyake et al. (2012), even though the Δ14C values are on average higher than the ones reported from the original study.
records.reason: The new measurements are explicitly compared with and found to show the sharp rise reported by Miyake et al. (2012), establishing a direct retest. The supplied shipped original is Brehm et al. (2021), not Miyake et al. (2012).
